DocFlow · visual walkthrough

Cold workspace to
documents processing.

Your workspace is empty right now: no app, no warehouse, no schema, no agents. Follow these eight steps and you will be watching documents move through Agent Bricks in about fifteen minutes.

8 steps3 commands to copy 4 buttons to pressrun takes ~2 min
1

Create the app

3 to 5 min

This makes the app and its own identity in Databricks. It takes a few minutes because Databricks provisions compute for it.

paste into terminal
cd ~/projects/agentbricks-doc-demo && databricks apps create docflow

When it finishes it prints a URL ending in databricksapps.com. That is your app.

2

Upload the code and start it

1 to 2 min

One line: it syncs the source into your workspace and deploys it.

paste into terminal
cd ~/projects/agentbricks-doc-demo && databricks sync app /Workspace/Users/jvangordon@gmail.com/docflow-app --full && databricks apps deploy docflow --source-code-path /Workspace/Users/jvangordon@gmail.com/docflow-app

Wait for state: SUCCEEDED.

3

Give the app permission to fix things

30 sec

A brand new app has an identity with rights to nothing. Two grants let it repair the workspace by itself instead of sending you to the console.

paste into terminal
cd ~/projects/agentbricks-doc-demo && ./.venv/bin/python docs/grant_app.py
What this actually does

Gives the app the "Allow cluster creation" entitlement so the warehouse button works, and USE CATALOG plus CREATE SCHEMA so the catalog button works. It prints exactly what it granted. Skip it and the app still runs and still tells the truth, it just cannot self repair.

4

Open the app and read the panel

1 min

Open your app URL. You land on Start. The left side is the setup form, the right side is the readiness panel, and it should be unhappy. That is the point.

✓App identity resolvespassing
!Serverless SQL warehouseCreate one
!Catalog workspace.docflowCreate schema
!Document volume writableCreate volume
✓Foundation models reachablepassing
○Knowledge AssistantCreate now
○Information Extraction agentsteps only
!Document Intelligence functionswaits for warehouse
○Billed usage availableinformational
Two things worth noticing before you touch anything

Go is disabled and the sentence beside it tells you why. And the Document Intelligence check offers no button at all, just a greyed note saying it comes after the warehouse, because there is no compute to test on yet. The app will not hand you a control that cannot work.

5

Press the fixes, top down

2 min

Order matters and the panel enforces it. Each button reports what happened underneath itself.

Create oneServerless SQL warehouse Creates a 2X-Small that stops itself after 10 idle minutes. About a minute.
Create schemaCatalog workspace.docflow Creates the schema the run writes into.
Create volumeDocument volume Creates the volume and its inbox, processed, secure, archive and generated folders.
Create nowKnowledge Assistant, optional You can skip this. Go creates it anyway. Pressing it early just starts the document index sooner.
Watch this happen

When the warehouse turns green, the Document Intelligence check below it stops waiting and validates itself, because there is finally something to test on. You did not press anything for that one.

Press Re-check when you are done. You want 6 of 6 required.

6

Fill in the four answers

1 min

Left side. These drive everything the run generates.

FieldWhat it changes
Customer nameAppears on every page and inside every generated document
IndustryThe vocabulary, the suggested questions, and the titles of both operations pages
Catalog and schemaWhere the tables, Genie space and run state live
DocumentsLeave as generate everything, or point at a volume of the customer's own PDFs
Try something other than Manufacturing

Insurance gives you "Loss Run Review" and vocabulary like subrogation and loss run. Logistics gives you "Freight Claims Recovery Desk". It is the most convincing thirty seconds of the demo and it costs nothing to try.

Press Save. It flashes Saved. Go is now enabled.

7

Press Go and watch it work

~2 min

The run log takes over the right side and streams with real timings.

AtWhat happens
~8sSchema, volume and tables confirmed
~16sCompany research, using a model on the AI Gateway
~34sDocuments generated, watermarked, into their own folder
~35sKnowledge Assistant created, indexing starts in the background
~36 to 120sDocuments processed: parse, classify, route, extract, audit, secure
~120sGenie space created over the extracted tables, then Ready

Switch to Flow while it runs. This is the screen to show a customer.

8

The payoff

3 min

Three screens carry the story once the run is done.

Ask — the suggestions under the box are written for your industry and are guaranteed answerable from the data this run produced.

Claims and Suppliers are the two operations screens. Built lists everything the run created with per section timings.

✓

Stand it down

10 sec

Nothing bills while idle. The warehouse stops itself after 10 minutes and Databricks stops the app 24 hours after deploy. To stop both immediately:

paste into terminal
databricks apps stop docflow
If a fix button fails

The message leads with what to do about it, and Databricks' own wording sits behind a "what Databricks reported" disclosure. Usually it means step 3 was skipped or did not finish.

Every screenshot on this page is a real capture of the app running against a Databricks workspace. Nothing is mocked up.
